title: handle_email_parse declares not_found Vec that is always empty and never populated
description: email.rs:869 — let not_found: Vec<Value> = Vec::new(); is declared, never populated, and the conditional serialization is dead code. This is a remnant from before JMAP-450.2's bug was recognized. Until JMAP-450.2 is fixed, remove the dead variable and emit Value::Null directly.
